result.summary: Several visual layout and truncation issues: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and horizontal carousels appear clipped without clear affordance.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is heavily clipped on the right; only part of the image and name ('Trattoria Piccol') is visible, so the card looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have consistent width/padding and either fully show the last visible card or add clearer horizontal scroll peek with proper clipping margins.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis treatment that preserves readability.
issues.suggestion: Use a proper text overflow style (ellipsis) and/or allow two-line names so titles remain understandable.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible), which looks unfinished and may hide more filters.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the horizontal scroller and a visible peek of the next chip so truncation looks intentional.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is cut off by the tab bar, so the offer image and content feel incomplete on first view.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so cards clear the fixed tab bar, or ensure the first card fully fits above the nav.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over food imagery with soft contrast on light plates (e.g. poke bowl), slightly reducing legibility.
issues.suggestion: Add a stronger scrim, border, or darker badge background so time labels stay readable on all images.
